# Branchline 0.4.1
This update improves diff scrolling, gives long branch and file names more room, and adds optional stability reporting.
- Fixed a freeze that could occur when rapidly flicking the trackpad through a file diff. Momentum scrolling no longer feeds back into diff anchor layout. - The repository sidebar and commit inspector can now be widened further to make long branch names and file paths easier to read. - Added **Settings → Diagnostics** with optional crash and macOS-provided hang reporting through Sentry. Reporting is off by default. You can enable it, send a non-crashing test report, or turn it off and discard pending local reports. - Reports contain technical stack traces, app/macOS versions and recent Git operation types. Repository names, branch names, paths, source code, diffs, terminal output, credentials and license details are excluded. No screenshots or session recordings are collected. - Updated the privacy notice to explain optional reporting. macOS controls hang diagnostics; not every freeze will produce a report.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Existing activation, open repositories and drafts are preserved. To help diagnose issues on another Mac, enable **Share crash and hang reports** in Settings → Diagnostics after updating.

# Branchline 0.4.0
This release makes branch tracking clearer and adds recovery tools for everyday Git work.
- Branches now show separate indicators for local-only branches, missing upstreams and upstreams with a different name. Set or change the upstream from the branch menu, with consistent push destinations that preserve existing tracking settings. - Choose a persistent graph color for a branch from its context menu. - Browse stashes in the sidebar, inspect their files and full diffs, and apply, pop, delete or create a branch from the selected stash. Actions keep targeting the same stash even when the list changes. - Risky history operations create durable backups. The Recovery workspace lets you inspect and restore the saved state, including after reopening the app. - Automatic stash is enabled by default for supported merge, rebase, pull, cherry-pick and revert workflows. Staged, unstaged and untracked changes are preserved, with explicit recovery choices if restoring them conflicts. Each repository has its own automatic-stash setting. - Recovery now includes an on-demand Lost commits graph. Search commits found in local reflogs, inspect their changes and recover them into a new branch without switching your checkout. Commits still protected by branches, worktrees, stashes or operation backups stay out of this view. - Fixed a diff scrolling feedback loop that could disrupt the reading position.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Existing licenses and the stable update channel remain unchanged.

# Branchline 0.3.1
This update fixes four issues found during a manual audit of the installed application.
- Interactive rebase now protects ignored local files before resetting or replaying history, including recovery after a pause. - Worktrees with a paused Branchline rebase cannot be removed, renamed or updated from another worktree, even after their window is closed. - Editing older commit messages, squashing and dropping commits now respect commit signing settings. Signing failures preserve a path to retry or abort instead of producing unsigned history. - Submodule conflicts now show the current and incoming commit choices. Resolving the parent reference preserves the submodule's local files and checkout. Unreadable conflicts stay visibly unresolved, with retry and recovery available.
Existing licenses and the stable update channel remain unchanged.

# Branchline 0.3.0
- Manage linked worktrees directly from branch menus: open an existing worktree, rename its branch, or remove the worktree with the option to delete its local branch. Removal previews show the target and local changes, with recovery guidance when an operation cannot finish. - Compare branches and commits with your current branch or working directory. Search the changed files and read each diff in the full center workspace. - Update a selected branch with fast-forward or merge, choose its upstream, and pull or push the intended branch even when it is open in another worktree. - Edit commit messages, drop a commit, or open an interactive rebase for commits after a selected point. Review the affected history and published-commit warning before applying changes; the planner supports message changes and reordering. - Pin a branch's first-parent history to the left of the graph. The preference is remembered per repository and shared with linked worktrees; hiding or soloing branches temporarily pauses the pin without losing it.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Supports Apple silicon and Intel. Existing personal invitation licenses continue to work. Paid checkout availability is announced separately after store approval.

# Branchline 0.2.0
- Large changed-file lists now recycle visible rows, reducing memory use while scrolling and searching. - Opening changed-file search defers text focus until the field is ready, avoiding expensive layout work in the click transaction. - Adds support for purchased licenses with separate device allowance, perpetual covered-version access and an update eligibility date. Existing personal invitation codes continue to work. - License Settings can release a Mac's activation and open purchase management. Paid terms and privacy notices are available in English and Turkish. - Updates check purchased coverage before downloading and again before installation; repository history, drafts and recovery remain accessible if a release is outside coverage.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Supports Apple silicon and Intel. Paid checkout availability is announced separately after store approval.

# Branchline 0.1.0
The first official release of Branchline by Kylindravia: a native Git workspace for macOS.
- Follow commit history with expandable branch folders and resizable graph columns. - Open full-size file diffs and resolve conflicts in a focused window workspace. - Stage files, hunks and lines, preserve commit drafts, and switch between open repositories. - Find changed files instantly by file name or folder path, including previous names of renamed files. Search works in both Folder tree and Flat list, shows the result count, and keeps your open diff. - Install from the signed and Apple-notarized DMG. Future versions arrive through signed in-app updates.
Requires macOS 14 or later; the universal application contains Apple silicon and Intel code. The release has been exercised on Apple silicon/macOS 26; macOS 14 and physical Intel coverage remains limited. Feedback and feature requests are welcome through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ahmet12/branchline-releases/issues).
App use requires an individual activation code provided by the developer. Current free personal access lasts 180 days from first successful activation on one active Mac. There is no required beta testing program, public trial, paid checkout or automatic subscription.
[Personal Access Terms and Privacy Notice](https://github.com/ahmet12/branchline-releases/blob/main/USAGE.md)
